explanations: rag_llm-The NCBI_accession record explicitly states geo_loc_name: 'Brunei' for sample KU521484. The corresponding publication Methods section confirms "five from Brunei" within the 12 island of Borneo samples, and accession number KU521484 falls within the deposited range KU521394-KU521507 from that study. [Sources: NCBI_accession (geo_loc_name attribute, 'Brunei'); https://doi.org/10.1007/s00439-016-1640-3 (Methods section, 'five from Brunei… Accession Numbers KU521394-KU521507')] [Conflict: none] [ID-match: true]

rag_llm-Same as modern/ancient field; this sample is from a living contemporary population (living Brunei individual), not from archaeological or ancient material. [Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features: 'organism: Homo sapiens'); https://doi.org/10.1007/s00439-016-1640-3 (Methods section, 'population samples… haplogroups… genetic variability general population')] [Conflict: none] [ID-match: true]

[Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features, 'organism: Homo sapiens'), web_search_https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/KU521484/ (record title, 'Homo sapiens isolate BRU60')]

isolate.explanation: NCBI BioSample attribute isolate is 'BRU60', confirmed by NCBI Nucleotide record title containing 'isolate BRU60'. [Sources: NCBI_accession (isolate attribute, 'BRU60'), web_search_https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/KU521484/ (record title, 'isolate BRU60')]

geo_loc_name.explanation: NCBI BioSample attribute geo_loc_name is 'Brunei', confirmed by NCBI accession data listing country as 'brunei'. [Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features, 'geo_loc_name: Brunei'), NCBI_accession (country attribute, 'brunei')]

tissue.explanation: NCBI BioSample all_features attribute specifies 'organelle: mitochondrion', indicating mitochondrial DNA source. [Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features, 'organelle: mitochondrion')]

mol_type.explanation: NCBI BioSample all_features attribute specifies 'mol_type: genomic DNA', indicating the molecular type of the sample. [Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features, 'mol_type: genomic DNA')]

db_xref.explanation: NCBI BioSample all_features attribute specifies 'db_xref: taxon:9606', the NCBI taxonomy reference for Homo sapiens. [Sources: NCBI_accession (all_features, 'db_xref: taxon:9606')]

study_design.value: Phylogeographic study of mitochondrial DNA haplogroups in Southeast Asia and Taiwan
study_design.explanation: The paper Methods section states: 'We selected 114 samples belonging to 10 haplogroups in the region of Southeast Asia... We included 2 from China, 23 from Taiwan, 61 from MSEA (22 from Vietnam; one from Thailand; 31 from Peninsular Malaysia; 4 from Laos and three from Myanmar (Burma)); 26 from ISEA (12 from island of Borneo—three from Kota Kinabalu (Sabah, Malaysian state), five from Brunei...'. This sample (BRU60 from Brunei) is part of a phylogeographic study of maternal genetic heritage in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. [Sources: https://doi.org/10.1007/s00439-016-1640-3 (Methods, 'We selected 114 samples belonging to 10 haplogroups... five from Brunei')]
